read_optimization_remarks: read LLVM optimization remarks from a YAML file and return max hotness, all remarks, and file-organized remarks
gather_optimization_results: gather and merge optimization remarks from multiple YAML files using parallel processing with a configurable number of jobs
find_optimization_files: find all *.opt.yaml* files recursively in given directories or files, excluding mounted directories
demangle_cpp_function_names: demangle C++ mangled function names using c++filt via a shared subprocess with thread-safe locking
parse_analysis_passed_missed_remarks: parse LLVM optimization analysis, passed, and missed remarks from YAML with automatic YAMLObject deserialization
